transport: A straight UTP cable with RJ45 connectors into any free RJ45 socket on the inverter/charger or on any unit of a VE.Bus system. No Ethernet, no IP, no Venus OS. Optional screw terminals on the back for an external transfer switch's auxiliary relay.

sharedMapEvidence: One vendor manual covers both — Victron publishes a single document titled 'Digital Multi Control / Digital Multi Control 200/200A', rev 00, 10/2023, with no GX variant split anywhere in it. But there is no register map to share: the manual describes a knob, a display, a mode switch and a six-parameter configuration walk-through, and contains no addresses, no baud rate, no framing and no slave ID.
gotchas: THE 'GX' IN THE NAME IS NOT A GX DEVICE. The vendor's own manual for this product is titled 'Digital Multi Control 200/200A' with no GX suffix, and it never uses the words Modbus, MQTT, VRM, Ethernet or Venus. It does not run Venus OS. Compatibility per the manual: MultiCompact; MultiPlus, MultiPlus-II and MultiPlus-II GX; Quattro and Quattro-II; EasySolar and EasySolar-II GX; and legacy pre-VE.Bus Multi/MultiCompact/MultiPlus/Quattro from 2008 and earlier.
